evam'eva kho, poṭṭhapāda, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, ek'antasukhī attā hoti arogo paraṃ maraṇā'ti.
kiṃ pana, bhante, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti? etam'pi kho, poṭṭhapāda, mayā abyākataṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti.
tath'āhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, yathā khīṇ'āsavo bhikkhu kāyassa bhedā ucchijjati vinassati, na hoti paraṃ maraṇā'ti.

examples.text: ahaṃ kho'mhi uccākulā pabbajito, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na uccākulā pabbajitā'ti. so tāya uccākulīnatāya attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo.

43084.meaning2: defeated, conquered, subdued, beaten in a game
43084.commentary: (DHPa) parājito'ti parena parājito kadā nu kho paccāmittassa piṭṭhiṃ daṭṭhuṃ sakkhissāmī'ti dukkhaṃ seti sabb'iriyāpathesu dukkham'eva viharatī'ti attho.

examples.text: jayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, dukkhaṃ seti parājito, upasanto sukhaṃ seti, hitvā jayaparājayaṃ.
